environment: Claude Code cloud container used only as a development tool; Linux, Node.js 22, local headless Chromium 1194

checks.skip_reason: Opt-in browser review, export and player tests; run separately with MOTION_REVIEW_BROWSER

checks.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_codex_install.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_package_identity.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_gepa_studio_pilot.py (optional GEPA dependency installed)

boundary: Source checks, container mixes and the owner listening to container renders; how ChatGPT or ChatGPT Work run the sound tools is not verified. All 201 planned cases remain not_run.

runs.design: every video is analysed and its effects and music designed anew (generate.py, compose.py, recipe.py); 200 designs for one profile gave 71 distinct major and 38 distinct minor progressions; effects for one video designed in about 0.25 s
runs.timing: 20 designs of four examples planned and checked: no timing failure, worst judged hit 1.46 ms; the reveal on the music downbeat within 0.01 ms
runs.loudness: example mixes -14.0 to -14.3 LUFS, true peak at most -1.5 dBTP before encoding; every designed role within 5 dB of its approved level (the landing swish 6 to 16 dB under the old knock)
runs.quality_gate: every designed sound keeps no third of an octave above 150 Hz over 70 to 85 percent of its energy by role, or is designed again
runs.owner_listening: 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08: audit fixes and palettes heard; knock and snare rejected as flat and empty; the owner then asked for newly designed sound for every video; generative renders heard, the opening landing swoosh judged too loud and not swoosh-like, fixed (a levelling bug of about 27 dB) and approved
